description: Returns a property matched by full or parsed street address, including property details and optional contacts. A matched property costs one property credit; returned contacts can consume people credits. No credits are charged when no property matches. `contact_audience=none` returns property-only data.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts

fields.description: DealMachine property field IDs to include in results

full_address.description: Complete address string (e.g. "123 Main St, Austin, TX 78701"), as an alternative to the parsed address fields

street.description: Street address component only (e.g. "123 Main St"); separate city, state, and ZIP fields are available

name: dealmachine_enrich_address
